newsitem.title: USA: VTX files reorganization plan with court.
newsitem.headline: VTX files reorganization plan with court.

text.p: VTX Electronics Corp said Thursday it filed a bankruptcy reorganization plan that calls for its VTX Technologies Inc unit to merge with the company to form a new company, Vertex Computer Cable and Products.

The company said existing VTX shareholders will receive one share in the new company for each five shares they hold. T.W. Cable LLC, which bought VTX's distribution business in June, will receive 22.77 million shares, representing a 90 percent stake in the new company.

Holders of the company's 12.65 million current outstanding shares will receive 2.53 million shares under the planned one-for-five exchange ratio on August 8, VTX said, adding it expected the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Westbury, N.Y., to confirm the plan by September 30.

The proposed plan also calls for an initial distribution to all unsecured creditors of 13.5 percent for each allowed claim and future distributions based on cash flow over the next five years, VTX said
Vertex's chief executive Ed Goodstein, who also is the president of private T.W. Cable, said the new company plans to focus on manufacturing cable assemblies.
